designs.title: Jingle Bams Mahjong Christmas Tree Tile
designs.description: For the friend who'd rather be at the mahjong table this Christmas. A bamboo-tile Christmas tree with a pun every mahjong player will get. A fun gift for your mahjong group, game-night host or holiday swap.
